sections.heading: C2 — Vehicle equipment, maintenance, trip planning and confusables
sections.markdown:
## C2 — Vehicle equipment, maintenance, trip planning and confusables

FACT_ID: sec12-F23 | anchor: A81
You cannot be a safe driver unless your vehicle is properly equipped and mechanically sound, and Alabama law sets the safety equipment required. [A81]
Source: [A81 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec12-F24 | anchor: A81
Every automobile needs two separate ways of applying the brakes: a regular foot brake and a parking brake. [A81]
Source: [A81 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec12-F25 | anchor: A81
Every vehicle needs a working muffler that stops excessive or unusual noise, and muffler cutouts, bypasses and similar devices are forbidden. [A81]
Source: [A81 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec12-F26 | anchor: A81
The exhaust system must not leak carbon monoxide into the vehicle and should be checked periodically. [A81]
Source: [A81 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec12-F27 | anchor: A81
Any motor vehicle with a windshield must have wipers in good working order. [A81]
Source: [A81 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec12-F28 | anchor: A81
All vehicles must have rear view mirrors that let the driver see 200 feet behind. [A81]
Source: [A81 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec12-F29 | anchor: A81
Required lighting includes a minimum of two white headlights, one or more red taillights, a brake light, and a light over the rear license plate. [A81]
Source: [A81 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec12-F30 | anchor: A81
All lights must be visible from at least 500 feet, and the high beam must light objects at least 350 feet away and stay properly aimed. [A81]
Source: [A81 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec12-F31 | anchor: A81
Flashing both turn signals, or another pair of lights, at the same time to warn of a vehicle hazard is permitted. [A81]
Source: [A81 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec12-F32 | anchor: A81
In crashes, steering assemblies cause 30 percent of fatal injuries and hitting the windshield, its frame or the dash causes another 40 percent, second collisions that safety belts can prevent. [A81]
Source: [A81 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec12-F44 | anchor: A81
Children under six years old need special child and infant restraints to protect them from serious injury or death. [A81]
Source: [A81 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec12-F33 | anchor: A82
Traffic crashes are the leading killer of children, and child and infant restraints keep small children from becoming flying missiles in a crash. [A82]
Source: [A82 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0082]

FACT_ID: sec12-F34 | anchor: A82
Every motor vehicle needs a working horn, and bells, sirens or exhaust whistles are allowed only on emergency vehicles. [A82]
Source: [A82 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0082]

FACT_ID: sec12-F35 | anchor: A82
Use the horn only to give a warning reasonably needed for safety, never to announce arrival or call passengers, because needless use can lead to arrest. [A82]
Source: [A82 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0082]

FACT_ID: sec12-F36 | anchor: A82
Buy tires rated to carry your car's weight, check pressure often, never drive on under-inflated tires, and have uneven wear checked for wheel or alignment problems. [A82]
Source: [A82 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0082]

FACT_ID: sec12-F37 | anchor: A82
A tire is illegal once its tread is less than 1/16 inch deep. [A82]
Source: [A82 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0082]

FACT_ID: sec12-F38 | anchor: A82
Avoid jack-rabbit starts and screeching stops unless truly necessary, go easy on corners and rough roads, let tires cool on long hot trips, and check the spare now and then. [A82]
Source: [A82 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0082]

FACT_ID: sec12-F39 | anchor: A82
Never use different types of tires, and ask your dealer before mixing types between front and back. [A82]
Source: [A82 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0082]

FACT_ID: sec12-F40 | anchor: A83
Brakes, exhaust, cooling systems, lights, wipers and tires wear out, and any one left unmaintained could cause a serious crash, so have the car checked. [A83]
Source: [A83 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0083]

FACT_ID: sec12-F41 | anchor: A83
Plan freeway trips with a map, deciding exactly where you will get on and off. [A83]
Source: [A83 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0083]

FACT_ID: sec12-F42 | anchor: A83
Check fuel, water and oil before a freeway trip, because no service stations sit directly on freeways, and check every tire, including the spare. [A83]
Source: [A83 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0083]

FACT_ID: sec12-F43 | anchor: A83
Most children hurt or killed in pupil transportation are outside the bus, struck by drivers who ignore its flashing red lights and stop arm, in the area called the DEATH ZONE. [A83]
Source: [A83 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0083]

FACT_ID: sec12-R01 | anchor: A81
Rear view mirrors must show 200 feet behind, while every light must be visible from 500 feet and high beams must reach 350 feet. [A81]
Why it matters: group_hint equipment-distances; prereq_hint sec12-F23; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec12-F28, sec12-F30.
Source: [A81 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec12-R02 | anchor: A80
A diamond interchange lets you enter and leave with the flow on four ramps, and any left turn comes only after you are off the freeway, never on it. [A80]
Why it matters: group_hint interchanges; prereq_hint sec12-F15; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec12-F17, sec12-F18.
Source: [A80 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0080]
